reconcile-statements-invoices.eventDescription: Charged per execution of reconcile_statements_and_invoices (1:1, cross-currency FX, and N:1 subset-sum matching plus formula-safe OpenXML .xlsx and UTF-8 BOM CSV generation).

extract-pdf-tables-to-xlsx.eventTitle: Extract & Clean PDF/Messy Tables to XLSX
extract-pdf-tables-to-xlsx.eventDescription: Charged per document converted by extract_and_clean_pdf_tables_to_xlsx into styled OpenXML .xlsx, Markdown, and formula-injection-safe UTF-8 BOM CSV.

repair-cjk-csv-mojibake.eventDescription: Charged per file repaired by repair_cjk_csv_mojibake (GB18030/GBK/Big5/Shift-JIS/UTF-16/UTF8-as-Latin1 recovery + OWASP CSV formula neutralization).

validate-multichain-address.eventDescription: Charged per execution of validate_multichain_address across EVM, Tron, Bitcoin, Solana, TON, XRPL, Cosmos, and Stacks.

decode-audit-evm-calldata.eventDescription: Charged per execution of decode_and_audit_evm_calldata for ERC-20/721/1155, Permit2, DEX router, Multicall, and Safe transactions.

audit-eip712-signature.eventDescription: Charged per execution of audit_eip712_signature_payload for Permit, Permit2, Seaport, EIP-3009 x402, and meta-transaction typed data.

actor-start.eventDescription: Flat initialization charge covering container boot overhead on standalone batch runs.
